title: Atlas Dataset Canonical Record
description: Canonical, model-agnostic record format for the Atlas AI Dataset Foundation. Every curated example MUST validate against this schema. Conversion to model-specific templates happens downstream in processing/converters and never mutates this canonical form.

id.description: Globally unique, stable identifier. Recommended format: <category>_<subcategory>_<zero-padded-seq>. Must match pattern ^[a-z0-9_]+$.

category.description: Top-level taxonomy bucket. Must be one of the 9 Atlas categories defined in metadata/categories.json.

subcategory.description: Free-form but SHOULD align with the allowed subcategories listed for the parent category in metadata/categories.json.

source.description: Provenance metadata. Never modify original sources; record them here.

name.description: Human-readable source name (e.g. 'Qwen Technical Documentation', 'Internal Knowledge', 'Open Source Repo X').

url.description: Canonical URL or file path for the origin. May be empty for fully internal content.

license.description: SPDX identifier or human-readable license. Use 'CC-BY-4.0' for internal author content, 'proprietary' for restricted, 'unknown' only during ingestion (must be resolved before curated/).

date.description: ISO-8601 date the source/content was created or captured (YYYY-MM-DD).

messages.description: Ordered conversation turns. Must contain at least one user turn and one assistant turn. See chat_schema.json for the item contract.

allOf.description: Must contain at least one assistant message.

language.description: ISO 639-1 language code (optionally with region, e.g. 'en', 'en-US', 'zh'). Default 'en'. Used for coverage auditing and multilingual expansion.

difficulty.description: Optional 1-3 rating of task difficulty (1=easy, 2=medium, 3=hard). Aids curriculum/stratified sampling. Omit if not assessed.

tags.description: Free-form keyword tags for retrieval and balancing. Lowercased, hyphenated recommended.

quality_score.description: Integer quality rating 1-10 assigned by quality_score.py and/or human review. 0 = unrated (pre-review).

verified.description: True only after a human reviewer approves the example for curated/.

notes.description: Reviewer notes, caveats, or provenance remarks. Empty string if none.
